title: Extract ssrf-guard crate
description: Validate outbound URLs/IPs against private/internal/reserved ranges. Source: GJ federation.rs:30-68 (most complete, includes IPv4-mapped IPv6, CGNAT). Public API: is_private_host(), validate_url(), is_private_ip(). Blocked ranges: loopback, RFC1918, link-local, CGNAT, broadcast, unspecified, IPv6 ULA/link-local, IPv4-mapped IPv6. Deps: url only. Consider async DNS resolution for TOCTOU mitigation.
